fourDimensionalNoGo.sameChargeExchangeCarFailure: T_A and T_B carry the same Standard Model representations. An antiunitary sends charge y to -y, so it cannot commute with the same-charge target action unless y=0.
fourDimensionalNoGo.bilinearGapFailure: No unordered pair of SM15 left-handed fields is a Lorentz-scalar Standard-Model gauge singlet. A gauge-preserving quadratic mass cannot gap one complete survivor.
fourDimensionalNoGo.kineticFailure: A positive nondegenerate kinetic matrix on the endpoint doublet propagates both copies. Setting one kinetic eigenvalue to zero makes the Gaussian/propagator singular rather than deriving a healthy projection.
fourDimensionalNoGo.finiteIndexTheorem: For a finite square map T:C^n->C^n, index(T)=nullity(T)-nullity(T^dagger)=0. A nonzero finite index requires an inserted dimension imbalance; an infinite-dimensional elliptic/Fredholm operator requires topology.
fourDimensionalNoGo.consequence: No local finite quadratic operator built only from the current four-dimensional endpoint-doublet inventory both derives three generations and turns the other same-charge survivor into CAR adjoints.

minimalConditionalCarConstruction.qualification: This is a consistent CAR polarization, but selecting T_selected and C^3 inserts both chirality and generation multiplicity.

minimalTopologicalEscape.whyTwoDimensions: A compact one-dimensional Dirac operator has zero complex index; a compact oriented two-dimensional spin-c geometry is the smallest standard setting with nonzero chiral Dirac index.
minimalTopologicalEscape.carReading: The conjugate bundle O(-3) and opposite Lorentz chirality form the Nambu/adjoint half, not an independent same-chirality mirror, after a self-dual CAR polarization is imposed.
minimalTopologicalEscape.qualification: The degree-three family line bundle, its connection and the higher-dimensional parent are new data. The existing charge-three flavon charge and Z3 BF level do not by themselves imply c1(L)=3.
